title: WARRANT path rule
description: A rule for everyone who edits the files matched by `paths` (ADR-0022). Lives in `rules/` of a pack (listed in `provides.rules`) or in `.warrant/local/rules/`; the file name without `.json` equals `id`.

id.description: Rule id, equal to the file name without `.json`.

paths.description: Glob patterns, relative to the project root, of the files the rule applies to.

text.description: The rule itself, as it is shown to the editor of a matched file.

enforced_by.description: What makes the rule mechanical: a check id or a command such as `validate`, `fmt --check`, `ids-valid` or `guard`. A rule without it is a decision, not a form.
